answer: Each new identity must post the same deposit, so spinning up N sybils costs N times the stake. Agents stake a sable-bonded copper deposit that unlocks only after sustained honest epochs. A rolling delta compares an agent's attested contribution against its historical baseline; identities diverging sharply get throttled. Because the copper bond is slashed on failed attestation and the sable tier gates voting weight, mass fake identities become economically irrational while honest agents recover their stake. In practice, Agent0040 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
